changes_only: define current funding signal as the most recently published funding settlement at or before completed hour t, never a future rate
for cash-and-carry use +0.5 spot and -0.5 perpetual gross-notional weights frozen at entry
apply round-trip cost cases to each leg and weight them by absolute entry notional; primary normalized two-leg friction is therefore 0.5*20 + 0.5*16 = 18 bps
realized positive funding is received by the short perpetual leg and counted only for settlements strictly after entry and at or before exit
one active trade per symbol for single-symbol carry families; a new signal may enter only after the prior position exits
no trade may cross a 21-day dependence-fold boundary or the development/holdout boundary
reverse negative-funding carry remains diagnostic-only because spot borrow is not modeled
cross-sectional funding-spread positions are evaluated as one portfolio trade with equal long/short gross sleeves before lagged-beta neutralization
unchanged: all signal thresholds and holding horizons
development gates and maximum holdout candidates
leverage only after an unlevered holdout pass
no OOS, profitable-edge, or live-execution claim
